strategy_rules: Daily bet = best 2-leg parlay when BOTH legs are High/Elite, each >= 66% model win probability, and the best pair clears 52% combined probability
Picks the highest combined-probability pair from the top 6 qualifying legs — NOT a blind top-2 rank parlay
If no parlay clears that bar, bet the single best High/Elite pick (never force a weak parlay)
Stakes: 50% of wallet on 2-leg parlays, 20% on singles (small bankroll tier) — parlay wins must move the needle
Validated blind walk-forward with real closing odds + $10 compound bankroll:
full season: 67% ticket hit (40-20), $10->$182, bankroll never dipped below $10
parlay days only: 69% hit (9-4) on 13 qualifying days
last 7 game days: 5-0 singles, $10->$18.80 (recent slate had no parlay qualifiers)
Rejected forever: naive top-2 at 65% (45% hit, near bust), calibrated_parlay (53% hit, $0.81 min), looser 65/48 gates
